scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c MP Yadav b Ravi Bishnoi

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c MP Stoinis b Mohsin Khan

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b MP Stoinis

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c Mohammad Nabi b HH Pandya

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c Tilak Varma b Mohammad Nabi

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c JJ Bumrah b HH Pandya

balls.text: slower bumper outside off. David swings at it with all his might and skews it towards deep mid wicket. Plugs in the outfield and by the time Pooran gets it to Rahul, MI scamper back for three
four more! Half-tracker outside off and Mohsin gets met. Sits up beautifully for David and he pummels it past deep mid wicket!

goes straight up, but it lands safe! Hard length angled across the batter outside off. David has a swipe across the line and miscues it. Mohsin has to chase after it and run backwards. Puts in the dive but cannot get there. David gets two for his toil
shot! Low full toss well outside off. David moves across his stumps, gets under it and scythes it over extra cover. Much-needed boundary!
full just outside off. David plants his front foot and swings through the line. Does not middle it, though, and it ends up being a chip over the bowler's head
dug into the track on middle and off. David, having stepped across his stumps, is rushed on the pull and splices it into the on side. Splices it so badly that he can come back for two
cutter on a back of a length on off. David lets the ball come to him before easing it out to deep mid wicket
oh dear, that barely bounced! Cutter into the track just outside off. Grips and keeps awfully low. Barely gets up to the ankle and Coetzee somehow jams it off the inside edge into his pads
another slower bumper outside off. David gets across his stumps and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
slow, short and wide outside off. David has to wait an eternity for the ball to arrive and can only chop it straight to short third man
low full toss speared into off stump. Coetzee pushes it towards long on and gets David back on strike

knocks Nabi over! Hard length on middle and off. Skids off the surface and Nabi, who is looking to smash this into next week, is beaten by the extra pace. Clinks off the bottom part of the bat, hits his back leg and then crashes into off stump. That was bowled at 143.1kph and that did it for Nabi. Mayank gets his first!
full and wide outside off. David, having taken a step across his stumps, swishes at it but only connects with fresh air. Contemplates the review but does not go through with it eventually
David has arrived! Right in the slot on middle and leg. David picks it early enough and wallops it clean over deep backward square leg!
shot! Mohsin goes for the wide yorker but does not quite get it right. David sits back deep in his crease and blasts it past extra cover!

missed run-out chance! Fizzed into the pads. David, having walked across his stumps, misses his flick. Trickles off the pads towards Rahul. David, looking for the single, hares down, only to be sent back. Rahul, with his glove on, has a shy but misses
dug in short on off. Nabi picks the slower ball and hoicks it towards deep square leg

cleans him up with a corker! Searing yorker, angling into the base of middle stump. Bowled at 140.6kph and Wadhera does not seem to pick it early. He is late to get his bat down and the ball thumps into middle and leg. A handy knock but the end-overs fireworks will have to come from elsewhere!
off-pace on a length on middle and leg. Wadhera clears his front leg and heaves it away towards deep mid wicket
sizzling yorker on middle and off. David jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover. But hang on, the over is not finished yet. Naveen has overstepped...
slower delivery into the track on middle and off. Does not arrive at Wadhera and he has to drag it towards deep backward square leg

huge appeal, not given! Full length ball, which seems to pitch just outside leg. Wadhera looks for the expansive reverse lap and misses it. Gets pinned on the pads but the umpire is unmoved. Naveen is convinced he has gotten his man and talks his skipper into a review. The third umpire says he has additional information and that they will prioritise Ball Tracking. Ball Tracking shows the ball pitched outside leg, and umpire Ulhas Gandhe's call stands!
fullish on middle and off. David plants his front foot and pushes it towards long on
dug in short and following the batter outside leg. Wadhera advances and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
top yorker to start off. On middle and leg, and Wadhera can only squeeze it out towards extra cover
angled in on a back of a length on middle and leg. David places it perfectly between deep mid wicket and deep square leg, and hares back for two
darted in on a length on middle and off. Wadhera eases it to long off
another googly, on a back of a length outside off. David knocks it down the ground to long off
short just outside off. Wadhera gets onto the back foot and punches it towards deep point
four more! Fired in on a length but this is down leg. Wadhera gets inside the line and tickles it fine past the keeper!
googly on a length outside off. David stays back and jabs it towards backward point to get off the mark
four to end the over! Wadhera has torn into Mayank! Low full toss outside off. Wadhera can free his arms and even though the bottom hand comes off, he cracks it to mid off's right!
another maximum! Banged in short at 141.5kph. Wadhera almost takes his eyes off it but manages to swipe it over the sweeper at deep backward square leg!
nails the wide yorker. Wadhera jams down on it and digs it out towards backward point
hard length, slanting into off. Wadhera is tucked up for room and blocks it back to the bowler
short outside off. Zips off the surface and Wadhera, flashing hard at it, is beaten for pace. This was bowled at 147.2kph
Wadhera welcomes Mayank back with a six! Dug into the track on middle and off. 146kph but looks like Wadhera is waiting for it. Clears his front leg and swats it over the deep mid wicket fence!

Bishnoi flummoxes Kishan! Slows up the googly on a length on middle and leg. Kishan, feeling the pinch of the scoring rate, has a huge mow across the line. Does so without getting to the pitch of the ball and it spins just enough to take the top edge. Swirls towards short third, where Mayank does the rest!
fired in on a length on leg stump. Wadhera gives himself a bit of room and knocks it to long on
shot! Fuller outside off. Wadhera brings out the sweep again and absolutely nails this one. Scorches across the turf and beats Pooran at deep mid wicket!
safe! Shortish on middle and off. Spins away because it is a googly. Kishan tries to pull it and hits it on the bounce to long on
darted in on a back of a length on the pads. Kishan has a swing at it and misses. The ball pops up off the pad and Rahul collects. A bit of an appeal but a polite enquiry at best
follows the batter well outside leg. Wadhera paddles it away but cannot beat short fine leg

good effort! Floated up full and wide outside off. Wadhera throws his hands at it and drives it uppishly towards extra cover. Stoinis dives sharply to his right but cannot hold on to a tough one-handed chance
slower and slightly shorter just outside off. Kishan hangs back and flat-bats it to long on
slanted in at the stumps. Kishan can only prod it towards extra cover
hard length on middle and off. Kishan hops back and slugs it down the ground. Turner tracks it from long on and reins it in, saving two in the process
slowed up and bowled fuller on middle and leg. Wadhera pokes it to the bowler's left for one
shortens the length after seeing Wadhera advance. The batter can only scuff it towards extra cover
googly again, this time on a length on middle and off. Wadhera does not pick it and wafts at it. Edges it down to short third for a single
darted in full at the stumps. Kishan brings out the reverse and picks up a single to deep point

sharp work by Rahul, but is it enough to catch Kishan out?! Another wrong'un, and Bishnoi gives this plenty of revs. Drops on Kishan and forces him to drive at it. In trying to reach out, he over-balances and Rahul does brilliantly to whip off the bails. The question now is whether Kishan has gotten back in time. His back foot did not seem to leave the ground at all and was behind the crease too. But after Rahul took off the bails initially, there was more movement of the back foot. Rahul uprooted the stumps but Kishan had his back foot just behind his crease at that particular moment. Danger averted!
very full on the pads. Kishan gets down on one knee and paddles it towards short fine leg
googly floated up on a full length on off. Kishan lunges forward and pokes it into the off side
fired in full on the pads. Wadhera bunts it towards deep mid wicket. He wanted the second but Kishan sent him back. Wadhera slipped while turning back but no damage done in the end
finds the fence! Long-hop on middle and off. Kishan picks the length really early, opens up his stance and belts it to long on's left!
full on middle and leg. Wadhera gets forward and nudges it into the mid wicket region. Hooda runs after it and retrieves, preventing the second
shortish just outside off. Wadhera gives himself room but cuts it straight to extra cover
fuller on middle and off. Kishan comes forward and knocks it to long off
length just outside off. Wadhera presses half forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket
fired in on a length on off. Kishan waits in his crease and works it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a length on off. Wadhera goes feeling for it away from his body and is beaten on the outside
slightly fuller outside off. This is a googly too and it fizzes past Wadhera's attempted cut. Should have been forward to that length
length outside off. Kishan stays back and jabs it towards extra cover

almost takes out the umpire! Back of a length delivery that pitches on off. Goes on with the angle and Kishan, standing up tall, bashes it back at the bowler. Bishnoi flings out his right mitt but cannot get anything on it. Michael Gough did well to get out of the way too!
short and too wide outside off. Kishan lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
shortish outside off. Kishan reaches out for it and punches it past extra cover for a couple of runs
back of a length outside off. Kishan hacks it back to the bowler
length ball way outside off. Kishan throws his hands at it and flays it towards deep point
up and over! Change of pace and this is dug into the track outside off. Sits up for Kishan and he forehands it over mid off!
back of a length on off. Kishan stays back and defends
another bumper on off. Kishan has a swipe at this too but is early into the stroke. Squirms past his swinging blade
back of a length on middle and leg. Wadhera uses the pace and the angle to help it towards deep backward square leg
slower ball bowled quite full and wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines and called a wide

dropped, oh dear! Short ball on off. Kishan rocks onto the back foot and gets a decent piece of it. Hits it towards Turner at deep mid wicket, who puts down a fairly regulation chance. Bursts through his hands and pings him on the forehead
another cutter, on a back of a length on the stumps. Wadhera tries to nudge it to the bowler's right and pick up a single but he does not get it far enough away from Naveen
banged in short on middle and leg. Goes on with the angle and Wadhera sways out of the way. Might have been an off-pace bouncer, was bowled at just under 121kph
back of a length on middle and off. Wadhera shuffles across and bunts it into the open spaces in the mid wicket region. Dashes back for two
slow and short on leg stump. Kishan steps inside the line and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Wadhera goes back and punches it past extra cover
fullish on middle and off. Kishan comes forward and pushes it towards mid off for a single
back of a length, angling into middle and off. Wadhera hangs back and defends
back of a length just outside off. Whistles off the surface and whistles past Wadhera's flailing blade too
gets it through! Hard length outside off. Bowled at 152.8kph but Wadhera has set himself up for this. Sits back in his crease and muscles it to mid off's right!

short outside off again. This seems to be a change-up and Wadhera swings too early. Not called a wide, and Mumbai want this checked. Inside the tramlines and it is below Wadhera's head too. MI burn a review!
goes for the bumper and this has been called a wide for height. Wadhera left it alone much better too. The Free hit continues
short outside off. Kishan hops up onto his toes and cuts it towards deep cover point. That was bowled at 145.5kph, and Mayank has overstepped too...
length just outside off. Kishan coms forward and jabs it towards short extra cover

oh my! Sharp short ball just outside off. Wadhera, without even looking at the ball, tries to duck out of the way. Ducks into the line of the ball in the end and the ball grazes off the lid towards third man. 144.1kph that!
banged into the track on middle and leg. Holds in the surface and Kishan is too early into the pull. The ball hits him on the body, after he had completed his stroke
excellent yorker on middle and leg. Wadhera jams down on it and squeezes it out towards fine leg
full just outside off. Wadhera presses forward and plays it back to the bowler
length outside off. Wadhera gets a positive stride in and pats it towards backward point

gone first ball! This is going from bad to worse for the Mumbai Indians! Length ball angled into the fifth stump channel. The ball pitches and straightens ever so slightly. Hardik goes feeling for it and only manages to nick it through to Rahul. Mumbai in all sorts of strife, and LSG are over the moon!

appeal for an lbw initially! Zipped in full and the ball finishes on leg stump. Tilak plays all over his flick and gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls away towards Bishnoi at backward point, who takes aim and hits the stumps at the batter's end. This could be tight. Tilak went walkabouts after the ball struck his pad. Looks like Bishnoi has gotten his man. Tilak is just short of his ground, and that is a superb bit of fielding. MI in big, big trouble!
short outside off. Kishan gets up on his toes and pokes it towards extra cover. That seemed to hold in the surface just a bit
hard length on middle and off. Tilak stands tall and punches it back past the bowler. Naveen tears across to his right from mid on, dives and keeps it to a single
back of a length in the channel. Pitches and straightens. Tilak, having backed away, fiddles at it and is beaten on the outside
back of a length just outside off. Tilak hangs back and pats it gently into the off side
short, wide and punished! Too much width and that is fodder for Tilak. Throws his hands at it and flays it over point for four!
dug into the track outside off. Tilak has a swipe across the line but only connects with fresh air. Beaten by the lack of pace and the angle across him
right up in the blockhole on middle and leg. Kishan digs it out towards mid wicket
short and following the batter outside leg. Tilak is cramped for room and can only bunt it towards mid on for a single
hard length just outside off. Tilak tries to go downtown but cloths it on the bounce to mid on
angled into the stumps. Tilak gets a half stride in before defending. Might have been a cutter, was bowled at 128kph
banged into the track just outside off. Tilak sizes it up early and sways out of the way
full just outside off. Kishan presses forward and drives it to mid on for a sharpish single
fullish just outside off. Kishan goes searching for it and chunks it off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg
full on middle and off. Tilak comes forward and pushes it towards mid on to get off the mark

another appeal, and called a wide again! Reviewed again! Shortish, angling into the body. SKY tries to help it fine but gets cramped for room. There seems to be a noise when the ball went past him, and Rahul thinks SKY has gloved it. The ball is pretty close to the gloves, and Rahul is indeed right. There is a spike when the ball is next to the gloves, and SKY has to go!
short on leg stump. Kishan gets onto the back foot and swings it away towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on leg stump. SKY opens up his stance and punches with a straight bat through mid wicket. Pooran gives chase and cuts it off via a dive. Saves a run
shot! Marginally short on middle and off. SKY picks the length early, stands up on his toes and dumps it over the deep square leg fence!
another cutter, on a hard length just outside off. Hits SKY high on the ball and dribbles towards mid off for a single
off-pace on a length just outside off. SKY presses half forward and punches it to mid off
back of a length on off. SKY gets behind the line of the ball and defends

four and out! Full just outside off. Does not shape back in and if anything, continues on with the arm. Rohit, trying to cover drive, slices it and hits it uppishly towards Stoinis at short extra cover. Stoinis, down on one knee, takes it in front of his face, and Mumbai have been jolted early!
oh, hello! Full and wide outside off. Rohit knows there is no fine leg in place and fetches it, scooping it clean over the keeper's head!
full outside off. Kishan gets forward and punches it to mid off's right. Turner puts in the dive and saves three
angled in on a back of a length on leg stump. Rohit goes back and pushes it towards mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Rohit lets the ball come to him before tapping it towards short third man
length ball well outside off. Some shape away from the batter and Rohit lets it go. Rohit looks quizzically at the umpire but that seemed within the tramlines
shortish outside off. Kishan goes right back and dabs it towards deep backward point to get off the mark
length on middle and off. A bit of swing back into Kishan and he plays with a dead bat. Almost bounces up onto his stumps

Rahul appeals, but called a wide! Short and down leg. Kishan has a swing at it and seems to miss it. Rahul, though, thinks it has grazed the bat on the way and he reviews. Hooda too felt there was bat involved. No bat involved, and UltraEdge confirms it. Good call by umpire Ulhas Gandhe, and LSG lose a review in the first over!
back of a length on middle and leg. Kishan gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket. Just a hint of shape for Stoinis

just over mid off, and the Lucknow Super Giants scrape past the finish line! Fired in very full on off. A low full toss, in fact, and Pooran just manages to muscle it over David at mid off. Ambles across to the other end, and while it was not the most flashy finish imaginable, the Super Giants will take it. They will take it with both hands!

floated up full on leg stump. Pooran bunts it into the vast real estate in the mid wicket region and skips back for two. Surely saving two would have been the smarter option, rather than being right on the fence?
another slot ball outside off. Pooran gets his hands through the ball and drills it on the bounce to long off. Retains strike for the final over
four runs! Four vital runs for LSG! In the slot outside off. Pooran has another one of those wild whooshes across the line. Gets an inside edge and the ball races away past the keeper!
nails the wide yorker outside off. Pooran jams down on it and glides it past short third. Rohit tears across to his right from deep point, puts in the dive and saves two

full and wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines and called a wide by the umpire. Hang on, Mumbai want this checked, and they go upstairs. Surely this was a wide? It is beyond the tramlines, as first suggested, and the wide call stands!
length ball angled across the batter outside off. Pooran aims for the moon and gets nowhere close to the ball
dug into the track outside off. Krunal stays back and hacks it towards long on

oh, how has Kishan missed that?! Short and wide outside off. Badoni throws his hands at it and jabs it towards deep cover point. Scrambles back for two but he is always struggling. Kishan, after collecting, misses the stumps at the first go. Makes contact with the stumps on the second attempt and Badoni's bat, at that point, is up in the air as he dives, despite being past the crease. The question now is whether the bat was, at any point, grounded behind the crease. The third umpire does not think so, and Badoni has to walk back! LSG are not happy with the decision!
shortish on the stumps. Badoni opens up his stance and drags it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball dug into the track on off stump. Badoni has another hack at it. Early on the stroke on this occasion, and the ball hits him on the back bicep. It cannoned off the bicep into his helmet
back to back boundaries! Coetzee goes short again, this time on off stump. Badoni swings like a rusty gate and the ball flies off the top edge. Beats fine leg to his right comfortably!
fortuitous but they all count! Sharp back of a length ball on leg stump. Rushes onto Badoni and he is awfully late on the pull. Deflects off the thigh pad and rolls away past the keeper!
back of a length outside off. Badoni, without really looking at the ball, has a swish at it and only connects with fresh air

and Coetzee cleans up Turner! Coetzee is absolutely pumped! Slanted in on a length just outside off. Turner moves across, trying to lap it. Gets too adventurous, though, and Coetzee's extra pace means that he cannot quite nail the stroke. Might have grazed the inside edge on the way but the end result was the stumps lighting up. Surely LSG will not botch it from here?
back of a length outside off. Pooran hangs back and fences it towards backward point. Just the one run off the 17th over!
low full toss on off. Pooran comes forward and drives it straight into the stumps at the other end
back of a length just outside off. Pooran gets behind the line and plays with a straight bat
fuller, slanting into middle and leg. Turner flicks it confidently to long on
angled in on a length on middle and off. Turner is caught on the crease and defends
hard length just outside off. Turner gets up on his toes and prods it towards extra cover
low full toss on middle and leg. Turner tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
sprays this slower ball way outside off. Kishan cannot gather cleanly either, and LSG get two extras
cutter on a length just outside off. Pooran clears his front leg and swings for the hills. Only swats away a few flies in the process
off-pace on a length outside off. Turner waits for it and punches it towards deep cover point
nails the wide yorker. Pooran can only dig it out towards backward point
speared in full on middle and off. Turner eases it down the ground to long on
very full on middle and off. Turner plays it back to the bowler
back of a length outside off. Turner goes back and jabs it towards deep cover point to get off the mark

holes out to deep mid wicket! Another half-tracker but somehow, it fetches Nabi a wicket. Stoinis tries to mow it over cow corner but the bottom hand comes off as he slugs at it. Does not get the requisite power and Tilak takes the catch, right on the fence. Stoinis departs, but after playing what looks like a match-winning knock!
flighted up on a full length just outside off. Pooran has a huge swing at it and shanks it towards deep mid wicket
fuller on middle and off, and Stoinis cannot get under this. Drilled down the ground to long on
launched into the Lucknow night sky! Flighted up into the slot on leg stump. Stoinis plants his front foot, swings through the line and smokes it over long on!
Stoinis greets Nabi with a boundary! This is long-hop. Dragged down and well outside off. Stoinis rocks back and crashes it through point!
short again on off. Stoinis gets on top of this one, rolls his wrists and pulls it towards deep square leg
short ball on off. Stoinis looks for the pull but the two-paced nature of this surface means that he swings a tad early. Only a fresh-air shot
length just outside off. Pooran nudges it to extra cover's right and scampers across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Stoinis gets up on his toes and runs it down to third man. Brings up his fifty - this one has come off 39 balls!
length ball on the pads. Pooran tucks it away towards deep mid wicket and gets off the mark

Hardik has another! Hardik keeps badgering that hard length outside off, and Hooda's patience has run out. He has a wild slog at it and does not have any shape to play that stroke. Goes straight up off the outer half of the bat and Bumrah makes no mistake at mid off!
length outside off. Hooda advances again and punches it to long off
googly on a fullish length just outside off. Hooda wanders down the track but is not to the pitch of the ball. Plays all around it and gets struck on the pads
full on the pads. Stoinis pushes it to long on and is content with a single
googly on a length outside off. Hooda lunges forward and eases it to long on
shorter outside off. Stoinis goes back and punches it towards long off
shot! Floats it up into the slot just outside off. Stoinis plants his front foot and thrashes it over the bowler's head for four!
very full just outside off. Stoinis stabs it via a combination of inside edge and pad, into the off side
zips in a full and fast yorker on leg stump. Stoinis misses his flick and gets pinged on the pads. Going well down leg, though
Bumrah tests out the middle of the track. Just outside off and Stoinis sways out of the way
gets the wide yorker right. Hooda jams down on it and guides it towards third man
back of a length outside off. Leaves the batter late and Hooda only wafts at thin air
shortish outside off. Stoinis stands tall and cuts it towards deep point
short, wide and put away! Not a great ball. Lots of width for Hooda to tuck into and he carves this over backward point!
another bouncer and this has been called a wide for height. Well over the batter's head. That's both bouncers done for the over
banged into the track on middle and leg. Stoinis opens up his stance and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
bumper outside off. Sails over the batter's head, or so it seems. The square leg umpire does not share that assessment, though. Not called a wide
short and wide outside off. Hooda reaches out for it and toe-ends it down to third man
back of a length on middle and leg. Hooda gets behind the line and pushes it towards mid wicket
short outside off. Stoinis has a swipe at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg
slower ball goes awry first up and slides down leg. Some exercise for the umpire
length just outside off. Stoinis gets on top of the bounce and punches it neatly towards deep cover point
back of a length on off. Hooda punches it towards mid wicket for a single
sharp bumper on middle and leg, which is a riposte to Hooda advancing. The batter has to take evasive action and just manages to sway out of the way
cutter on a back of a length outside off. Hooda hangs back and dabs it towards backward point
this is shorter on middle and leg. Hooda gets on top of the bounce and pulls it past mid wicket for a brace
almost! A bit of a half-tracker on off. Does not bounce up very high but Hooda does well to time it. Swipes it uppishly towards deep square leg, and beats Nabi to his left!
slowed up and bowled fuller outside off. Hooda has a slog at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep square leg
googly on a back of a length on off. Stoinis sits back in his crease and chips it over the bowler's head
short and wide outside off. Stoinis reaches out for it and scuffs it towards deep cover point. The sweeper misfields and Stoinis gets the second
full just outside off. Hooda stretches forward and pushes it to long off
fuller on middle and leg. Stoinis sticks to the sweep and collects a single to deep backward square leg
lovely! Given a bit of air and this lands in the slot on the stumps. Stoinis gets down on one knee and smites it over mid wicket!
hard length just outside off. Bounces a little extra and Hooda splices his punch towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Stoinis punches it crisply towards deep cover point
length just outside off. Stoinis presses half forward and plays it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Hooda tucks it off his pads towards fine leg and gets off the mark

goes a mile up, and taken by Nabi! Hardik takes out his opposite number! Hard length just outside off. Rahul tries to heave it over the leg side but shanks it a little. Gets more elevation than distance. Nabi settles himself on the deep square leg fence, and takes a smart catch, while balancing and ensuring he did not step onto the cushion. Massive moment in the game!
length just outside off. Rahul presses half forward, stays on top of the bounce and drives on the up past extra cover. Rohit mops up on the fence and keeps it to two
back of a length outside off. Stoinis stays deep in his crease and dabs it towards backward point
slightly fuller on the stumps. Stoinis comes forward and jams it towards short mid wicket
slider on a length on the pads. Stoinis, having advanced, gets a tickle and the tickle is fine enough to beat the sweeper at fine leg!
length on off. Stoinis is caught on the crease again and spars it off the outside edge towards backward point
length on middle and off. Stoinis hangs back and defends
dropped! Floated up full outside off. Rahul plants his front foot and powers it towards short extra cover. Hardik dives sharply to his right and can just get a hand to it. A half-chance, at best
banged in shorter outside off. Stoinis jumps up onto his toes and drops it into the off side with soft hands
off-pace on a length outside off. Stoinis comes half forward and defends into the off side
shortish just outside off. Stoinis gets up on his toes and defends
peach! Length in the channel just outside off. Jags away against the angle and breezes past the outside edge of Stoinis' bat
pick the bones out of this one! Another off-cutter that lands right in the slot outside off. Stoinis reads this like the morning daily and thumps it over long off!
slower ball on a length outside off. Stoinis does not pick the slower one and fences at it too early. Squirms past the inside edge in the end
this is a shot and a half! Thushara goes for the leg-stump yorker but errs on the shorter side. Rahul gets his front foot out of the way and then helicopters it over mid on!
four more! Too short and too wide outside off. Fodder for Rahul. He sits back in his crease and knifes it past backward point!

clears the fence, just! In the slot on off. Rahul shuffles across his stumps, snaps his wrists into the stroke and whips it away. Deep backward square leg is interested for the longest while but Rahul has gotten just enough on it to clear him!
cutter on a length just outside off. Stoinis punches it towards the bowler, who misfields and can only parry it towards long on
shorter outside off. Rahul gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep cover point
Rahul gets his first boundary! A proper freebie. Half-volley well down leg and all Rahul has to do is get bat on it. Much-needed boundary for the LSG skipper!
action replay of the last ball! Short again on the stumps and this is playing into Stoinis' hands. He hops back and pounds it past mid wicket!
shot! Half-tracker on off, and now Stoinis is waiting for it. Stands up on his toes and bludgeons it past mid wicket for four!
fuller on the pads. Stoinis brings his wrists into play and tucks it off his pads past mid wicket. Deep square leg runs around to his left and cuts it off
dug into the track outside off. Stoinis rocks back and pulls it over mid wicket. Did not time it as well as he would have liked and the ball plugs in the outfield
back of a length on middle and leg. Rahul uses the pace and glances it down to fine leg
fires this down leg. Rahul swings and misses, and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
shortish outside off. Stoinis hops up onto his toes and punches it to mid off's left for one
off-pace again, on a back of a length outside off. Stoinis tries to force it through the off side but ends up shanking it to mid on
slower ball on a full length outside off. Rahul gets onto the front foot and drives it towards deep point
back of a length just outside off. Rahul gets behind the line and meets the ball right under his eyes
back of a length on off. Rahul hangs back again and defends into the off side
off-pace on a length outside off. Rahul presses half forward and punches it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and off. Rahul gets behind the line and defends
full and well down leg. Rahul does not make contact and the umpire calls it a wide
streaky! Terrific in-swinging yorker, which tails in late into the stumps. Stoinis just about jams his bat down and squirts it off the inside edge past fine leg!
back of a length on middle and off. Rahul has a poke at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards deep square leg
angled in on a full length on off. Rahul comes half forward and stabs it towards short mid wicket
in-swinging full delivery on middle and leg. Rahul accounts for the inward movement and flicks it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length in the channel. A smidgen of shape away from Rahul and he drops it into the off side
back of a length outside off. Nips back in with the angle and cramps Rahul for room. Defended off the back foot
length outside off. More movement away from the batter and Stoinis lets this one go
oh! Full outside off and this shapes away very late. Stoinis goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge

big appeal, not given! Speared in full and this swings away late. Kulkarni, having walked down the track, plays all over it. The MI players ask Thushara where this has pitched, and Hardik then signals for the review, rather theatrically. No bat involved. All eyes on Ball Tracking now. Pitching in line, impact in line and the ball would have been smashing into the middle of middle stump. First IPL wicket for Thushara; first-ball duck for Kulkarni!
back of a length outside off. Rahul gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep cover point
fullish on middle and off. Rahul presses forward and pushes it towards mid on
starts off with a slingy full toss on middle and off. Rahul comes forward and taps it gently down the ground
